Digitizing The
Traditional Trade Market

Cartona is Egypt’s fastest-growing B2B E-commerce marketplace. Bringing the marketplace online, Cartona connects buyers and sellers across the supply chain. These ties grant merchants efficient and profitable growth, so we can all grow equally.

Available on
Google Play

Download on
App Store

STREAMLING OPERATIONS

Enabling Retailers to Reach Their Full Potential

Retailers browse Cartona to compare and order merchandise, saving time, money, and effort, while retailers browse the platform to seamlessly find and purchase items 24/7.
Cartona’s marketplace directly and conveniently connects retailers to FMCG producers and wholesalers, significantly facilitating business.
Cartona is committed to digitizing sales, establishing a comprehensive digital network of retailers, and creating a user-friendly interface, eliminating the inefficiencies of the traditional marketplace.
FORGING PARTNERSHIPS

Growing Hand-in-Hand

 

Cartona forged partnerships with several market players and smaller businesses. Partnering with FMCG companies, we aimed to establish a one-stop shop for thousands of retailers to use daily to buy small or mass amounts.

When companies partner with Cartona, they can

Boost the efficiency of their salesforce and transport operations

Expand their user base and orders

Gain real-time data insights and
performance tracking

Optimize their marketing strategy by targeting and customizing promotions

Want to grow together? Reach out for a partnership potential

SIGN UP

BRIDGING GAPS

Mass Nationwide Impact

 

Supporting local businesses and filling market gaps, wholesalers working with Cartona can

FUTURE DRIVEN

A Technology-Integrated Solution

By adopting an asset-light business model, Cartona aims to empower the marketplace rather than disrupt it.

Our user-friendly network offers customized app solutions to maximize the gains of retailers, suppliers, and sales teams.

We embrace a cashless society and adopt BNPL (buy now, pay later) financing methods, investing in embedded finance and providing retailers and suppliers with integrated solutions to boost financial inclusion.

OUR CULTURE

We are a tech-driven, youth-led, entrepreneurial and innovative company with a meaningful impact.

Cartona – Egypt’s Fastest Growing B2B Platform – Raises $8.1mln

Cartona, the leading B2B platform digitizing and empowering stakeholders of Egypt’s traditional trade market – including mom-and-pop stores, hotels, restaurants, ​​cafes, FMCG companies, ​​and ​wholesalers – announces the successful completion of an $8.1 million ​​Series A extension ​fundraise.Read more

Cartona Partners With AMAN Holding, A Leading Egyptian Fintech Company.

Cartona partners with AMAN Holding, one of Raya Holding’s subsidiaries and a leading Egyptian fintech company that provides easy financial solutions to its customers using smart technology.

Cartona Partners With Talabat, The Leading Food Delivery Service In The Region.

Cartona partners with Talabat, the leading food delivery service in the region, to revolutionize the procurement of restaurant supplies. This collaboration aims to streamline the supply process for Talabat’s partners, offering a user-friendly online purchasing experience with exclusive discounts and diverse payment options.

يستطيع التجار طلب كل ما يحتاجه متجرهم من تطبيق مكسب، بما يشمل أكثر من 9,000 منتج بين أغذية ومشروبات ومنتجات غير غذائية، بدلًا من التواصل مع كل مورد على حدة.

يجمع سوق مكسب تجار الجملة وتجار التجزئة في تطبيق واحد؛ يعرض تجار الجملة منتجاتهم، ويستطيع التجار التصفّح والشراء منهم مباشرةً، ما يمنحهم تشكيلة أوسع من المنتجات والموردين في مكان واحد.

شبكتنا

تتصل مكسب بالموردين وتجار الجملة والبنوك لتوفير كل ما يحتاجه التاجر في مكان واحد؛ تتيح هذه الشبكة للتجار الوصول إلى تشكيلة واسعة من المنتجات والحصول على خدمات مالية، كل ذلك عبر منصة واحدة مبنية حولهم.

الموردون

مصنّعون وموزّعون يعرضون كتالوجهم الكامل أمام آلاف التجار.

تجار الجملة

تجار جملة محليون يعرضون ويبيعون مباشرةً عبر سوق مكسب.

البنوك والشركاء الماليون

شركاء يشغّلون المدفوعات والمحافظ الإلكترونية وتمويل التجار داخل المنصة.

الخدمات المالية

عبر تطبيق مكسب وماكينات نقاط البيع، يستطيع التجار تقديم باقة كاملة من الخدمات المالية لعملائهم من خلال مكسب كاش؛ يمكنهم تنفيذ مدفوعات الفواتير وإضافة رصيد للمحافظ الإلكترونية وإتمام المعاملات اليومية بسرعة وموثوقية، وبأفضل أسعار العمولات في السوق.
